_about: POI type styles for Mapa's + points groups — the style guide presets. One entry per CSV `type`; `default` applies to every point (and to a blank or unknown type), and a type's keys are layered on top of it. Keys: shape (circle | star-dot | square | triangle | diamond | star | cross | wye, or "" / none for no marker — label only), size (marker radius in px, same visual size for every shape), fill, stroke, stroke-width, opacity, label-size, label-color, label-font (family), label-style (normal | italic), label-weight (e.g. 500), label-case ("upper" = shown in capitals), label-halo-color, label-halo-width. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Edit and reload mapa.html.
_source: Label sizes/colours: Figma 'Data viz style guide updates Oct 2026' › locator map v3 › Locator maps › Land fill, borders, and labels — DESKTOP column (w 800). Socials (375×469) column in _socials. Markers (› Markers: icons, labels & legend): capital = filled dot #000000 12p desktop / 9p socials (a plain circle, per the designer — the Figma light-mode icon shows a star in the dot, the dark-mode spec says filled dot); city = filled dot #000000 9p desktop / 7p socials. `size` is a radius, so 12p → 6.
_comment_areas: Area labels — no marker, centred. country = context land; focus = the subject on white land; focus-copper = the subject on Data Copper land; related = a country in a focal relationship with the subject.
